newsitem.title: USA: Apache Medical names Robert Sullivan CFO.
newsitem.headline: Apache Medical names Robert Sullivan CFO.

text.p: APACHE Medical Systems Inc said Monday that Robert Sullivan has joined the company as vice-president, treasurer and chief financial officer.
He assumes positions previously held by Brion Umidi, who is leaving the company to enter a family business.
Sullivan was previously vice-president, chief financial officer, secretary and treasurer for AMISYS Managed Care Systems Inc, a software company now part of HBO and Co.
APACHE provides software and systems for the health care industry.
